lines.en: label toukadorm25p2:
scene toukawalktwo1
: You would be {i}foolish{/i} not to marry me! Only an imbecile would deny such a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
lines.zh: : 不娶我你就是个{i}傻瓜{/i}！只有蠢货才会拒绝这种千载难逢的机会！

lines.en: : Tsukasa?! What are you doing out here so late?! And...what are you wearing?!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa？！你这么晚在外面干嘛？！还……穿成这样？！

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo2
: And you! Heir or not, I will not allow you to ridicule me just because you’re older than I am! I’m just as fit to lead this family as you are!
lines.zh: : 还有你！管你是不是继承人，我不许你仗着比我大就嘲笑我！我跟你一样有资格领导这个家族！

lines.en: : That’s not what I was-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个——

lines.en: : Silence!
lines.zh: : 住口！

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo3
: It’s just as Jeeves said. You and Mother are always looking down on me and treating me like some sort of...pawn!
lines.zh: : 就像 Jeeves 说的那样。你和母亲老是瞧不起我、把我当某种……棋子！

lines.en: : Technically, that is not what I said at all. It does involve the same people, though.
lines.zh: : 严格说，我根本没说过那种话。不过涉及的人倒是同一批。

lines.en: : Silence, Jeeves. I heard all I needed to hear from across the stream. And I do not know who this “Maya” person is, but if I fit your “tastes,” I would be happy to marry you.
lines.zh: : 住口，Jeeves。我在小溪对面该听的都听见了。我不知道这个「Maya」是谁，但要是我合你的「口味」，我很乐意嫁给你。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo4
: Tsukasa! That was a joke!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！那是玩笑！

lines.en: : Mm...Maybe “happy” isn’t the right word to describe how I’d feel about marrying you. But if it would get Onee-sama and Mother to begin taking me seriously, so be it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许「乐意」这个词形容我对嫁你的感受不太准。但要是这能让姐姐大人和母亲开始正眼看我，那就这样吧。

lines.en: : I feel like marrying me is the worst possible way to get {i}anyone{/i} to take you seriously. Also, you are a child.
lines.zh: : 我觉得嫁给我是让人「{i}正眼看你{/i}」的最烂办法。再说，你还是个孩子。

lines.en: : In the days of old, it was common practice for men of your age to take girls like me as a bride! Because, while I may not be capable of bearing children now, those days are not far away!
lines.zh: : 在古代，你这个年纪的男人娶我这样的女孩当新娘是常事！因为，虽然我现在还生不了孩子，但那样的日子不远了！

lines.en: : Okay. Time to leave.
lines.zh: : 好了。该走了。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo1
: You are going nowhere!
lines.zh: : 你哪儿也别想去！

lines.en: scene black
Tsukasa marches forward and pushes me aside so she can stand near her sister.
lines.zh: Tsukasa 大步上前把我推开，好站到她姐姐旁边。

lines.en: Just to clarify, though, she is not strong enough to physically move me on her own. I just decide to do the right thing and step out of the way. I swear I’m not actually weak.
lines.zh: 不过说明一下：她力气没那么大，单凭她自己推不动我。我只是做了对的事、主动让开。我发誓我其实并不弱。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo5
: Tsukasa, what on earth are you doing wandering around dressed like that?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，你到底穿成这样在外面晃什么？

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} am getting engaged.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}在订婚。

lines.en: : {i}No,{/i} you are not.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}，你没有。

lines.en: : And {i}also,{/i} I am on my way to meet Mother in the pool area. Which, according to the schedule, {i}you{/i} should be doing as well. So it appears that {i}you{/i} are the one not properly dressed, dear sister.
lines.zh: : {i}而且{/i}，我正要去泳池区见母亲。按日程，{i}你{/i}也该去的。所以看来，穿错了衣服的其实是{i}你{/i}，亲爱的姐姐。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo6
: The...{i}pool{/i} area? But Mother informed me this was an important family meeting that could take up the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 泳……{i}泳池{/i}区？可母亲说今晚有场重要的家庭会议，可能开到后半夜。

lines.en: : Is bonding with your family not “important” to you, Onee-sama? Or are you just too busy flirting with my fiance to care?
lines.zh: : 跟家人增进感情，对你不算「重要」吗，姐姐大人？还是说你光顾着跟我的未婚夫调情，顾不上了？

lines.en: : I really don’t like how this is a thing now.
lines.zh: : 我很不喜欢这事居然成了「既定事实」。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo7
: Stop calling Sensei your fiance! It’s incredibly disrespectful and inconsiderate of his feelings!
lines.zh: : 别再叫 Sensei 你未婚夫了！这极其失礼，也完全不顾及他的感受！

lines.en: : But it was {i}your{/i} idea. And you never make mistakes because you’re the apple of Mother’s eye and {i}I{/i} am just the butt of all of your jokes.
lines.zh: : 可这是{i}你的{/i}主意。而且你从不出错，因为你是母亲的掌上明珠，而{i}我{/i}只是你们所有玩笑的笑柄。

lines.en: : Tsukasa!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！

lines.en: : I demand an apology. If I receive one, I will rescind my offer to marry your teacher and will return to simply campaigning for him to become my butler instead.
lines.zh: : 我要求道歉。只要我得到道歉，我就收回「嫁给你老师」的提议，回去接着单纯地「竞选」让他当我的管家。

lines.en: : And of course, you will need to apologize to Jeeves as well for breaking his poor, peasant heart.
lines.zh: : 当然，你还得为伤了 Jeeves 那颗可怜的平民之心向他道歉。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo8
: Weren’t you ever taught to abstain from eavesdropping on the conversations of close family members?
lines.zh: : 难道没人教过你，别偷听至亲的谈话吗？

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} I was too busy learning about forks.
lines.zh: : {i}没有{/i}。我忙着学「叉子」了。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo9
: Hah...I am sorry for including you in a conversation that was not, and I reiterate, meant to be a joke at {i}your{/i} expense, but Sensei’s.
lines.zh: : 哈……我为把你卷进一段「拿{i}你{/i}开玩笑」的谈话道歉——但我重申，那玩笑是拿 Sensei 开涮的。

lines.en: : Apology not accepted. Stating that it would be a joke at {i}his{/i} expense implies that you do not believe I am the exceptional marriage candidate we all know I am.
lines.zh: : 道歉不接受。说那是「拿{i}他{/i}开涮」的玩笑，言下之意是你不承认我是咱们都知道的那个「绝佳结婚人选」。

lines.en: : {i}No...{/i}it implies that his taste in women is even {i}less{/i} acceptable than it already is.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}……那言下之意是，他挑女人的品味{i}烂{/i}到超出已经够烂的程度。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo10
: Is Jeeves a lolicon?
lines.zh: : Jeeves 是萝莉控吗？

lines.en: : Tsukasa. Mind your manners. He’s still your elder.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa。注意你的言行。他毕竟是你长辈。

lines.en: : Barely. Like I said, in the days of old, it wasn’t uncommon for men of his age to-
lines.zh: : 勉强算吧。我说了，在古代，他这个年纪的男人——

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo11
: Enough!
lines.zh: : 够了！

lines.en: : Onee...sama?
lines.zh: : 姐姐……大人？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo12
: I apologize for raising my voice, but this discussion is over. It has already carried on far longer than it was meant to and now {i}I{/i} am beginning to get uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 抱歉{i}我{/i}提高了音量，但这场讨论到此为止。已经拖得远超本意了，我现在开始不自在了。

lines.en: : And Tsukasa, even {i}if{/i} you are on your way to meet Mother, you must not dress in such attire {i}prior{/i} to entering the pool room. It is inappropriate and unladylike.
lines.zh: : 还有 Tsukasa，{i}就算{/i}你正要去见母亲，进泳池房{i}之前{/i}也不能穿成这样。这不合规矩，不成体统。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo13
: But she said it was okay!
lines.zh: : 可她说可以的！

lines.en: : You are likely misremembering. But seeing as I must meet with her as well, I can find out myself.
lines.zh: : 你多半记错了。不过既然我也得去见她，我可以自己去问清楚。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo14
: Come. Both of you.
lines.zh: : 来。你们俩都跟我来。

lines.en: : Jeeves too?! But he isn’t even a part of the family yet!
lines.zh: : Jeeves 也去？！可他还不是我们家的人！

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo15
: Was the “yet” really necessary?
lines.zh: : 那个「还」字有必要吗？

lines.en: scene black
I follow the girls down a familiar path and several subsequent {i}un{/i}familiar passageways that I’m sure will ultimately lead to somewhere else I’ve been before.
lines.zh: 我跟着女孩们走下一条熟悉的通道，又穿过几条{i}陌生{/i}的走廊——我很确定它们最终会通到某个我去过的地方。

lines.en: Unless the Tsukiokas have multiple pool rooms of course which, honestly, wouldn’t be all that surprising.
lines.zh: 除非月冈家有好几间泳池房——不过说实话，那也不算多稀奇。

lines.en: What {i}is{/i} surprising, though, is Touka’s sudden shift in demeanor.
lines.zh: {i}真正{/i}稀奇的，是 Touka 态度的突然转变。

lines.en: I doubt it’s jealousy or fear that I would {i}actually{/i} take her sister’s uncallused hand in marriage, but it’s definitely {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 我不觉得那是嫉妒，也不是怕我{i}真{/i}会牵起她妹妹那双「没长茧的手」成婚——但肯定{i}有点什么{/i}。

lines.en: But whatever that {i}something{/i} is dissipates the moment chlorine meets our nostrils.
lines.zh: 可那点「{i}什么{/i}」，在氯气钻进我们鼻腔的那一刻就消散了。

lines.en: And she slinks back into the perfect girl she always is...for she never figured out how to survive as anything else.
lines.zh: 而她又溜回那个一贯完美的女孩模样……因为她从没学会过如何以别的方式活着。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo16
: Oh! Girls. And Ak- {i}ahem.{/i} And Sensei is here as well. What a pleasant surprise.
lines.zh: : 哦！女儿们。还有 Ak——{i}咳。{/i}还有 Sensei 也来了。真是个惊喜。

lines.en: : Nice save.
lines.zh: : 改口改得漂亮。

lines.en: : Mother! Tell Onee-sama it’s okay for me to walk around in my bathing suit! She didn’t believe me!
lines.zh: : 母亲！告诉姐姐大人我穿泳衣到处走没问题！她不信我！

lines.en: : Um...Mother? What exactly is going on here? I was under the assumption we had important matters to take care of tonight.
lines.zh: : 那个……母亲？这到底是怎么回事？我还以为今晚有要事要处理。

lines.en: : Is spending time with your family not important to you, dear?
lines.zh: : 跟家人待在一起，对你不算「要事」吗，亲爱的？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo17
: Ha. It’s just as I said. {i}You’re{/i} the only one here who doesn’t understand the situation, Onee-sama. And you call yourself a Tsukioka.
lines.zh: : 哈。果然跟我说的一样。这儿就{i}你{/i}一个人搞不清状况，姐姐大人。就你这样还自称月冈家的人。

lines.en: : It’s not that! I adore the brief moments we spend together!
lines.zh: : 不是的！我很珍惜我们相处的短暂时光！

lines.en: : But as Tsukasa says, there’s something I’m not understanding about this. Why would you make it sound like there was a formal meeting tonight?
lines.zh: : 但正如 Tsukasa 所说，这事我有点没搞懂。你为什么要把今晚说得像有场正式会议？

lines.en: : Did an esteemed guest...cancel? Was it something along those lines? I apologize for questioning you so directly, I just can’t seem to wrap my head around any of this.
lines.zh: : 是有位贵客……取消了吗？还是类似的情况？抱歉我这么直接地追问您，我只是实在想不通这一切。

lines.en: : Also, I do hope it’s okay that I brought Sensei along as well. I have already warned him that he may need to be locked away for the duration of our talk tonight.
lines.zh: : 另外，我把 Sensei 也带来了，希望您别介意。我已经警告过他，今晚我们谈话期间他可能得被「关起来」。

lines.en: : Locked away?
lines.zh: : 关起来？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo18
: Now, why would we go and do something like that to such a valued visitor?
lines.zh: : 我说，我们干嘛要对这么一位贵客做那种事？

lines.en: : I apologize in advance for staring. I can’t help it.
lines.zh: : 先道个歉，我会盯着看的。我忍不住。

lines.en: : And I apologize for making things {i}difficult{/i} for you. If I had known beforehand that you were coming, I would have worn something a bit less...revealing.
lines.zh: : 也抱歉给你添{i}麻烦{/i}了。早知道你要来，我就穿件不那么……暴露的了。

lines.en: : The reason I expect he’ll need to be secluded is that, despite the...attire required for tonight’s discussion, I’m sure we’ll still be going over matters that those on the outside must not-
lines.zh: : 我说他需要被「隔离」，是因为——尽管今晚的「讨论」需要穿成这样——我敢肯定我们还是要谈些外人绝不该知道的事——

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo19
: There is no “discussion,” dear. I lied to you because I wanted this to be a surprise.
lines.zh: : 没什么「讨论」，亲爱的。我骗了你，因为我想给你个惊喜。

lines.en: : You...what?
lines.zh: : 您……什么？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo20
: It was recently pointed out to me that my responsibilities with the foundation may have been...getting in the way of our relationship, so to speak.
lines.zh: : 最近有人向我指出，我在财团里的职责可能……可以说，妨碍到了我们的关系。

lines.en: : So I took it upon myself to arrange a night for the three of us to bond for several hours — free from the worries of what may happen to the company in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 所以我自做主张，安排了我们仨今晚好好相处几个小时——暂时不用操心公司那边会出什么事。

lines.en: : But I see now that, in doing so, I may have unintentionally gotten in the way of {i}another{/i} relationship of yours.
lines.zh: : 不过现在看来，这么做可能无意中妨碍到了你的{i}另一{/i}段关系。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo21
: In the way? Of course not. You’ve given me so much that you could never possibly be in the way of-
lines.zh: : 妨碍？怎么会。您给了我那么多，您永远不可能是「妨碍」——

lines.en: : Touka, darling, I believe that dress might be cutting off your circulation as I thought I made it {i}pretty{/i} clear just now that there is no such need for formalities tonight.
lines.zh: : Touka 亲爱的，我看这条裙子是不是勒得你血脉不通了——我以为我刚才已经说得{i}很清楚{/i}，今晚不需要任何客套。

lines.en: : Instead of taking up our normal places on the ladder, let us simply be mother, daughters, and...I’m sorry, what should we refer to Sensei as here?
lines.zh: : 今晚我们别按「等级」各就各位了，就当是母亲、女儿们，还有……抱歉，我们该怎么称呼 Sensei？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo22
: Unneeded.
lines.zh: : 多余的人。

lines.en: : Cannonball!
lines.zh: : 跳水！

lines.en: : No “cannonballs,” Tsukasa. You’ll hurt yourself.
lines.zh: : 不许「跳水」，Tsukasa。你会受伤的。

lines.en: : Tch. What use is Japan’s greatest medical staff if we’re unable to reap the benefits of it?
lines.zh: : 切。既然没法享用，那「日本最强的医疗团队」要来何用？

lines.en: : Should I go lock myself in your Holiday Inn Express?
lines.zh: : 要不我去把自己锁进你们那家「智选假日酒店」？

lines.en: : You are aware it is not an actual Holiday Inn Express, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你知道那不是一家真正的智选假日酒店，对吧？

lines.en: : Instead of that, why doesn’t he just join us in the water? Seeing as your father was unable to attend, he might be an adequate stand-in.
lines.zh: : 与其那样，不如让他也下水？既然你父亲来不了，他或许能当个不错的替身。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo23
: That won’t be necessary. I’m not-
lines.zh: : 不必了。我不——

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo24
: I’m not all that fond of swimming in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我本来就游得不怎么样。

lines.en: : Can you at least make your staring less glaringly obvious? Pun somewhat intended.
lines.zh: : 你能不能别盯得那么明显？一语双关，故意的。

lines.en: : Well, I’d feel horrible just having him sit around and {i}watch{/i} so...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，光让他坐着{i}干看{/i}，我心里过意不去，所以……

lines.en: : Oh! Here’s an idea. How about I spend some time alone with Tsukasa now and you and I can reconvene once Sensei heads home for the night?
lines.zh: : 哦！我有个主意。要不我现在先单独陪陪 Tsukasa，等 Sensei 今晚回家了，我们俩再会合？

lines.en: : Assuming he is not staying in our “Holiday Inn” of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是他没住我们这家「假日酒店」。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo25
: But I can’t just walk away from you after you went through the hassle of rearranging your entire schedule for our sake.
lines.zh: : 可你都为我们大费周章重排了整个日程，我不能就这么走开。

lines.en: : It won’t be walking away, darling. Why not show Sensei the sauna? Or perhaps stop by the buffet on the way to one of our many terraces?
lines.zh: : 那不算「走开」，亲爱的。何不带 Sensei 去看看桑拿房？或者在去我们众多露台之一的路上，顺道去趟自助餐厅？

lines.en: : I don’t mean to spoil the mood, but this is starting to sound more and more like a Holiday Inn as time goes by.
lines.zh: : 我不想扫兴，但随时间推移，这儿越来越像一家假日酒店了。

lines.en: : Will that not offend you after extending such a gesture? Because, as much as I appreciate the opportunity-
lines.zh: : 您都这么安排了，那样不会冒犯到您吗？因为，尽管我很感激这个机会——

lines.en: : Touka, go have fun. You and I will see each other later tonight. I’ll stay with Tsukasa for now.
lines.zh: : Touka，去玩吧。你和我今晚晚点再见。我先陪 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Hooray! I get Mother all to myself while Onee-sama spends time with a commoner!
lines.zh: : 万岁！我能独占母亲了，姐姐大人去陪平民！

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo26
: It’s beginning to sound as if we don’t have much of a say in the matter.
lines.zh: : 听着好像我们对这事没什么发言权。

lines.en: : Oh no. Whatever shall we do in a giant mansion filled with everything we could ever possibly want?
lines.zh: : 哦不。在一座装满我们能想象到的一切的豪宅里，我们可怎么办呢？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo27
: Good question. Well...the sauna is a no from me as I’d have to leave my mace behind. And I’ve seen the terraces a good thousand times already, so...
lines.zh: : 问得好。这个嘛……桑拿我不去，因为那就得把防狼喷雾留在外面。露台我也已经看过上千遍了，所以……

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo28
: Perhaps we could go have a little fun somewhere {i}private?{/i}
lines.zh: : 也许我们可以去个{i}私密{/i}点的地方，找点乐子？

lines.en: : There is absolutely no way that means what I want it to mean.
lines.zh: : 那句话绝对不可能是我想的那个意思。

lines.en: : Oh, we’ll see about that...
lines.zh: : 哦，那可不一定……

lines.en: scene black
scene toukawalktwo29
I was right.
lines.zh: 我猜对了。

lines.en: : At long last, Sensei...I can show you the true power of the Tsukioka family that has been handed down from generation to generation.
lines.zh: : 终于，Sensei……我可以让你见识一下月冈家代代相传的真正力量。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo30
: Something, something bloodlines and hidden power.
lines.zh: : 什么什么血统啊、隐藏力量啊之类的。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我不怕你，Touka。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo29
: But you should be. For I have not only replicated the dojo we had our first encounter in, but I have grown so familiar with it over time that it is now like a second home to me.
lines.zh: : 可你本该怕的。因为我不仅复刻了我们初次交手的那间道场，而且久而久之对它熟到，它现在就像我的第二个家。

lines.en: : You can’t have a second home inside of your home. That’s not how homes work.
lines.zh: : 你不能在自己家里再有个「第二个家」。家不是这么算的。

lines.en: : What I mean to say is that I will be able to use the environment to my advantage...while you, a man who has seen it but never {i}felt{/i} it, can do nothing to gain the upper hand.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我能利用环境占尽优势……而你这个只见过它、却没{i}「感受」{/i}过它的男人，休想占到上风。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo31
: That’s just what you think, {i}bitch.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那只是你这么以为，{i}小贱人{/i}。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo32
: Well, that was unnecessarily rude. I was just trying to have a little fun in the same way Ayane’s told me the two of you have before.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这也太没礼貌了。我只是想像 Ayane 说的你们俩以前那样，找点乐子。

lines.en: : But if you are going to be that unpleasant and offensive, I’ll have you locked up right now.
lines.zh: : 但你要这么难听又冒犯，我现在就把你关起来。

lines.en: : You and what army?
lines.zh: : 你叫谁？哪来的帮手？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo33
: Oh, yay! More roleplay.
lines.zh: : 哦耶！又有角色扮演了。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo34
: Me and my own personal army of assassins, trained in a form of ninjutsu so ancient and so forgotten that they’re the only clan left in existence who knows it.
lines.zh: : 我和我的「私人刺客军团」，他们练的忍术古老到被遗忘——现存世上只剩他们这一族还会。

lines.en: : Or at least that’s what {i}you{/i} think.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}你{/i}是这么以为的。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo35
: Ah! Are you saying {i}you{/i} know it as well?
lines.zh: : 啊！{i}你{/i}是说你也懂那套？

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I’m...
lines.zh: : 我正是那个意——

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo36
: Hah...
: This just feels weird without Ayane. No offense, Touka.
lines.zh: : 没有 Ayane 在，这感觉就是怪怪的。无意冒犯，Touka。

lines.en: : None taken. I didn’t want it to seem like I was trying to interfere in any memories you may have of her. I just believed it would help put you at ease in such an intimidating environment.
lines.zh: : 不冒犯。我不是想介入你对她的任何回忆。我只是觉得，在这么有压迫感的环境里，这样能帮你放松。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo37
: Thanks, Touka. But that really wasn’t necessary. I’m already starting to familiarize myself with this place.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Touka。不过真没必要。我已经开始熟悉这地方了。

lines.en: : Or at least I thought I was until I discovered several minutes ago that you’re now replicating locations from our daily lives inside of your mansion.
lines.zh: : 至少几分钟前我还这么以为——直到我发现，你们居然在自家大宅里复刻我们日常生活里的地点。

lines.en: : How else am I meant to practice interacting with others in such locations? This is the simplest method I could think of.
lines.zh: : 不然我还能怎么练习在这种场合跟人打交道？这是我能想到的最简单的办法。

lines.en: : You have issues.
lines.zh: : 你有毛病。

lines.en: : I do. But you’re not without issues as well, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我是有。但你也不是没毛病，Sensei。

lines.en: : Name one.
lines.zh: : 说一个来听听。

lines.en: : Well, to start-
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，首先——

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo38
: You’ve let your guard down.
lines.zh: : 你放松警惕了。

lines.en: : I’ve what-
lines.zh: : 我什么——

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo39
: HA!
scene black
scene toukawalktwo40
When I open my eyes, it’s as if I’m waking up from a dream.
lines.zh: 睁开眼时，我像从一场梦里醒来。

lines.en: My head is rested on the lap of a beautiful girl- who’s gently stroking my hair and completely ignoring the fact that she knocked me unconscious with a single kick just moments ago.
lines.zh: 我的头枕在一个美丽女孩的腿上——她正轻轻抚着我的头发，完全无视她刚才一脚把我踢晕的事实。

lines.en: As my eyes lock onto hers, there is a moment of intense intimacy that can’t really compare to anything else.
lines.zh: 当我的目光对上她的，那一刻的亲密感，是任何别的都比不了的。

lines.en: But just as I think about summoning what little strength I have left to lift this aching head and kiss her, my world comes crashing down.
lines.zh: 可就在我想聚起仅剩的力气、抬起这颗作痛的头去吻她时，我的世界轰然崩塌。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo41
And what I mean by that is her family shows up.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，她的家人出现了。

lines.en: But that’s okay because I was just making up all of that other stuff anyway.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为那些别的本来就是我编的。

lines.en: To be honest, my head hurts way too much to even lift right now in the first place.
lines.zh: 说实话，我的头现在疼得厉害，根本抬不起来。

lines.en: But I guess we can see how those two managed to misunderstand the situation before we dwell any further on that.
lines.zh: 不过，与其在这儿多想，不如先看看那两位是怎么误会的。

lines.en: : Oh my. Were we interrupting something?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我们是不是打扰到什么了？

lines.en: : Onee-sama! What are you doing with my husband?! Wench!
lines.zh: : 姐姐大人！你在对我丈夫做什么？！贱人！

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo42
: He is not your husband! He is my teacher! And I may or may not have unleashed my secret technique on him!
lines.zh: : 他不是你丈夫！他是我的老师！而且我可能、也可能没有对他使出了我的秘技！

lines.en: : Secret...technique?
: She’s been spending too much time with poor people. All they have is their imagination.
lines.zh: : 她跟穷人待太久了。穷人除了想象力什么都没有。

lines.en: : Before anyone misunderstands, it was a {i}fighting{/i} technique. Nothing else went on in here. At least not while I was conscious.
lines.zh: : 在有人误会之前，那是种{i}格斗{/i}技。这屋里没发生别的。至少我清醒的时候没有。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo43
: {i}What do you think you’re insinuating?! Do I look like the type to do something so heinous to a sleeping person?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在暗示什么？！我长得像那种会对昏睡的人做那种缺德事的人吗？！{/i}

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t know what kind of weird stuff you’re into.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我又不知道你有什么怪癖。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, why don’t you go take a bath and get ready for bed? I’d like to make good on my promise and spend some time with your sister alone.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，你去洗个澡、准备睡觉好吗？我想兑现承诺，跟你姐姐单独待一会儿。

lines.en: : Okay, Mother. But can we do this again soon? I had fun.
lines.zh: : 好的，母亲。不过我们很快能再这样玩一次吗？我很开心。

lines.en: : We’ll see, dear. There’s a lot more work I need to catch up on first.
lines.zh: : 再说吧，亲爱的。我还有好多工作要先补上。

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo44
: Will you be much longer? I don’t want to intrude more than I already have.
lines.zh: : 你们还要很久吗？我不想再多打扰了。

lines.en: : You haven’t intruded on anything! It really isn’t what it looks like! I just misjudged my own strength and knocked Sensei unconscious while sparring with him!
lines.zh: : 你根本没打扰什么！真不是看上去那样！我只是误判了自己的力道、跟 Sensei 切磋时把他踢晕了！

lines.en: : How long was I even out for?
lines.zh: : 我到底晕了多久？

lines.en: scene toukawalktwo45
: An hour.
lines.zh: : 一小时。

lines.en: : And you didn’t...think of taking me to the hospital? Or getting me any sort of medical care apart from a lap pillow?
lines.zh: : 而你就……没想过送我去医院？除了膝枕，就没给我任何医疗处理？

lines.en: : I did not. And stop whining.
lines.zh: : 没有。还有，别哼哼了。

lines.en: : Well, whenever you’re done, I’ll be waiting in my room — where I expect to hear a full explanation of why Tsukasa suddenly believes she is married.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你们聊完了就来我房间——我等着听一个完整解释：Tsukasa 为什么突然以为自己结婚了。

lines.en: scene black
: Yes, Mother...And I apologize for having you walk in on-
lines.zh: : 好的，母亲……还有，很抱歉让您撞见——

lines.en: if chikalust25 == True:
: Don’t.
: I can assure you I have walked in on much worse.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，我撞见过比这糟得多的场面。

lines.en: else:
: There’s nothing to apologize for, dear.
lines.zh: : 没什么好道歉的，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Just be glad it was {i}me{/i} and no one else.
lines.zh: : 庆幸来的是{i}我{/i}、不是别人就好。

lines.en: Tsubasa leaves the room and Touka assists me in pulling my head off of her lap.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 离开了房间，Touka 扶我把头从她腿上抬起来。

lines.en: It’s a premature departure I really wish I could have avoided for a bit longer but, seeing as I’ve already interfered in at least two hours of mother-daughter time, I should probably get going.
lines.zh: 这次「提前离场」我真想再拖一会儿，但既然我已经搅黄了至少两小时的母女时光，我大概该走了。
